Class Ability usage while within 15 meters of an enemy grants Grenade, Melee, Class Ability, and Super Energy.

Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods Equipped:
• Ability Energy: <pve 4% /> <pvp [2%] /> | <pve 6% /> <pvp [3%] /> | <pve 7% /> <pvp [3.5%] />
• Super Energy: <pve 2% /> <pvp [1%] /> | <pve 3% /> <pvp [1.5%] /> | <pve 4% /> <pvp [2%] />

#ChunkEnergyScalars (Super Energy gains are unaffected)
